tokoh_utama: A 25-year-old Indonesian man with short messy black hair, wearing a casual grey t-shirt.

part.pertanyaan: Kalau kamu yang beli mobil itu, kamu jual lagi atau tetap pakai?
part.caption: Beli mobil bekas murah banget, tapi isi dashcam pemilik lamanya bikin merinding.

adegan.narasi: Jangan pernah tergiur beli mobil bekas murah tanpa cek isi memori dashcam-nya.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of a hand holding a dusty memory card next to a car dashboard.

adegan.narasi: Kemarin aku beli sedan tua ini seharga sepuluh juta saja dari penjual online.
adegan.gambar: An old silver sedan parked in front of a modest Indonesian house at dusk.

adegan.narasi: Pas aku keliling malam hari, aku sengaja menyalakan memori dashcam bawaan pemilik lama.
adegan.gambar: Interior of a car at night, a small glowing dashcam screen mounted on the windshield.

adegan.narasi: Di rekaman itu, pemilik lama menyetir sendirian menembus jalanan desa yang sangat gelap.
adegan.gambar: Dashcam video perspective showing a narrow dark asphalt road surrounded by dense banana trees.

adegan.narasi: Pria itu terus melirik spion tengah dengan wajah pucat dan sangat ketakutan.
adegan.gambar: Inside the video playback, a nervous middle-aged driver glances anxiously at the rearview mirror.

adegan.narasi: Berulang kali dia gemetar dan berbisik ke belakang, "Tolong turun."
adegan.gambar: Close-up on the previous driver's mouth trembling inside the dark car interior.

adegan.narasi: Padahal kursi belakang mobil itu benar-benar kosong, tidak ada siapa-siapa di sana.
adegan.gambar: Camera view angle showing completely empty black fabric backseats illuminated faintly by streetlights.

adegan.narasi: Aku cuma tertawa menganggap pemilik lama itu cuma bikin konten rekayasa belaka.
adegan.gambar: The main protagonist sitting in driver seat laughing while holding his smartphone playback, reflected in the rearview mirror where two glowing eyes lurk faintly in the dark backseat.

adegan.narasi: Tapi rasa penasaran membuatku mengecek rekaman dashcam milikku sendiri tadi pagi.
adegan.gambar: Protagonist sitting at a desk in his bedroom, inserting a micro SD card into a laptop screen.

adegan.narasi: Rekaman itu memperlihatkan aku menyetir pulang sendirian menembus gerimis semalam.
adegan.gambar: Dashcam view from protagonist's car driving through rain-slicked city streets at night.

adegan.narasi: Tiba-tiba di menit kelima, suaraku sendiri terdengar gemetar di dalam rekaman.
adegan.gambar: Laptop screen displaying video wave audio spikes sharply in the middle of playback.

adegan.narasi: Aku mendengar diriku sendiri berbisik pelan, "Tolong turun."
adegan.gambar: Close-up of protagonist's pale face on laptop screen, looking terrified in the video playback.

adegan.narasi: Padahal aku sama sekali tidak ingat pernah mengucapkan kalimat itu semalam.
adegan.gambar: Protagonist staring horror-stricken at his laptop screen in a dim room.

part.pertanyaan: Ada yang lihat mata di spion? Di detik keberapa?
part.caption: Makin aneh, sabuk pengaman belakang narik sendiri padahal nggak ada orang.

adegan.narasi: Lanjutan kemarin, aku langsung memasang kamera tambahan yang mengarah tepat ke kursi belakang.
adegan.gambar: Hands mounting a small secondary action camera onto the car ceiling facing back seats.

adegan.narasi: Aku berniat membuktikan kalau mobil ini aman dan cuma halusinasiku saja.
adegan.gambar: Protagonist adjusting steering wheel with a determined expression inside car daytime.

adegan.narasi: Malamnya aku sengaja menyetir sendirian keliling kompleks perumahan yang sepi.
adegan.gambar: Car driving slowly down an empty suburban residential street with dim streetlights.

adegan.narasi: Saat mengecek hasil rekaman, kursi belakang memang terlihat benar-benar kosong melompong.
adegan.gambar: Video footage showing empty car backseat illuminated by red brake lights outside window.

adegan.narasi: Tapi anehnya, setiap kali aku menginjak rem, ada kejadian yang bikin merinding.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of protagonist's foot pressing hard on the car brake pedal.

adegan.narasi: Sabuk pengaman kursi belakang tiba-tiba tertarik kencang seperti menahan beban tubuh manusia.
adegan.gambar: Rear seatbelt pulled completely tight diagonally across an empty seat as if wrapped around invisible body.

adegan.narasi: Tali sabuk itu menegang keras seolah ada penumpang yang terdorong ke depan.
adegan.gambar: Extreme close-up of the mechanical seatbelt buckle stretched to its maximum limit.

adegan.narasi: Aku mencoba menenangkan diri dan lanjut memutar video detik demi detik.
adegan.gambar: Protagonist leaning close to video player, while outside the car window behind him, a shadowy gaunt silhouette sits blurred in the background light.

adegan.narasi: Tiba-tiba notifikasi ponselku berbunyi kencang, temanku mengirim pesan menyuruhku menjual mobil itu.
adegan.gambar: Smartphone screen glowing in dark car displaying text message: 'Jual mobil itu sekarang!'

adegan.narasi: Tanganku makin gemetar saat memutar bagian akhir dari rekaman video tersebut.
adegan.gambar: Protagonist's trembling hands holding phone screen displaying video frame.

adegan.narasi: Kamera tambahan di dashboard menangkap detail yang membuat jantungku serasa berhenti.
adegan.gambar: CCTV angle from dashcam looking towards the front seats from behind.

adegan.narasi: Di sudut bawah rekaman, tampak sepasang jari tangan pucat memegang erat sandaran kursiku.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of long, pale grey creepy fingers gripping tightly onto the top headrest of the driver's seat.

part.pertanyaan: Menurut kalian, kenapa sosok itu ikut pindah ke motor?
part.caption: Terornya nggak berhenti walaupun mobilnya udah dijual!

adegan.narasi: Lanjutan kemarin, aku nekat mencari tahu alamat rumah pemilik lama mobil ini.
adegan.gambar: Protagonist standing outside a modest old green house in a quiet neighborhood.

adegan.narasi: Keluarganya menangis dan bilang pemilik lama sudah hilang misterius tiga bulan lalu.
adegan.gambar: An elderly woman crying at her porch door, wiping tears with a handkerchief.

adegan.narasi: Mobil itu dulu ditemukan di tepi hutan, mesin masih menyala dan pintu belakang terbuka.
adegan.gambar: Flashback view of an abandoned car parked at night by dense dark forest trees, rear door wide open.

adegan.narasi: Ibunya berbisik pelan denganku, "Dia selalu bawa penumpang misterius dari jalan raya."
adegan.gambar: Close-up of the elderly woman leaning forward near protagonist with a terrified face.

adegan.narasi: Tanpa berpikir panjang, aku langsung menjual mobil murahan itu hari itu juga.
adegan.gambar: Protagonist handing over car keys to a buyer, sedan parked in background.

adegan.narasi: Aku merasa lega dan memutuskan kembali memakai sepeda motor kesayanganku untuk bekerja.
adegan.gambar: Protagonist putting on a black helmet next to his automatic scooter motorcycle outdoors.

adegan.narasi: Mengingat detail kecil di mobil, sosok itu ternyata menempel pada siapa pun pengendaranya.
adegan.gambar: Protagonist riding his motorcycle down an empty city highway under morning sun.

adegan.narasi: Pagi ini aku mengecek rekaman helm camera atau dashcam motorku saat jalanan sepi.
adegan.gambar: Small camera mounted on top of motorcycle handlebars recording forward road, while in motorcycle side mirror, two grey pale hands wrap around protagonist's waist.

adegan.narasi: Layar monitor menampilkan perjalanan kuliahku tadi pagi yang tampak biasa saja.
adegan.gambar: Smartphone playing back smooth clear camera footage of city road during commute.

adegan.narasi: Namun saat motor berhenti di lampu merah, bayangan di kaca spion terlihat ganjil.
adegan.gambar: Footage pauses at a red traffic light, camera angled slightly towards motorcycle rearview mirror.

adegan.narasi: Tepat di jok belakang motorku, ada sosok pucat sedang duduk menempel rapat di punggungku.
adegan.gambar: Close-up on motorcycle passenger seat in video footage, showing a tall pale scary figure with hollow dark eyes sitting right behind driver.
